body:
[7:00 PM] Dose taken, for fun and inability to concentrate.
Note: Took 40mg, my regularly prescribed dose, at 7:00 AM, no noticeable changes. Diagnosed with ADHD-C.
[7:30 PM] A strange pressure behind my eyes, similar to smoking some marijuana. No marijuana has been consumed. Decided to drink 100 mg caffeine.
[7:40 PM] Noises seem louder. I feel like I'm moving more quickly than usual. No other effects noted. Settled down to play a video-game.
[7:55 PM] Ate 8 pieces of sushi. Eye pressure disappeared. Feeling focused, almost a tunnel-vision-like effect.
[10:00 PM] Feeling focused and productive. Completed several tasks in my video game. Did my chores, and feeling no lethargy or signs of comedown. A general feeling of love and wellbeing has washed over me.
Note: Scalp is a little itchy, but not enough to be distracting.
[10:40 PM] Dry mouth. Drank a cup of water. Water tastes good.
[11:15 PM] Feeling extremely friendly, social, and energized. Like I'm on top of the world, and nothing can tear me down.
[12:40 AM] Still feeling wide awake and motivated. Hosted a social event in my video game. It feels like I'm more alert and responsive.
[1:00 AM] My fitbit is registering my pulse at 111 beats per minute, and I've just been laying in bed playing video games.
[1:15 AM] Went pee for the third time. Got another glass of water. Water felt gritty going down my throat.
[2:30 AM] Completed some more quests in my video game. Still feeling wide awake, still feeling focused. Heart rate steady at 102.
[2:40 AM] Took 1 mg of Klonopin to try to come down, due to having a dentist appointment in the morning.
[4:00 AM] Finally went to sleep.
[9:30 AM] Woke up with strange hangover-like effects. A rebound depression, as well as a slight headache and complete lack of energy.
